rationale: The frozen candidate carried both role-isolated advisory inputs required by standard-lesson-v3, from distinct agent runs and distinct model families, pinned to the same commit. The academic review returned request-changes with five major and three minor findings; the learning-design review approved with five notes and requested no change. Every academic finding was a bounded correction to a stated claim, an answer key, or a line of prose rather than a structural rebuild, so the maintainer repaired them in place. Two mattered most: a risk line that asserted an unqualified negative across domains nobody had asked about, and a recall study carried past what it measured. Both are now bounded to the evidence that exists. The academic verdict stands as dissent and no reviewer has seen the repaired text.
dissent: The academic review's request-changes verdict stands as material dissent from the candidate as reviewed. Its findings were incorporated by the maintainer afterwards; no reviewer has approved the repaired text.
conditions: The repaired content is committed first and that exact commit is stamped as finalCommit, with no teaching-content change afterward.
Strict source preflight and full validation must pass on the final content before merge.
The publication transition is the maintainer's separate act and is not authorised by this decision.
